# Microsoft

> > Microsoft's comprehensive digital ecosystem spanning productivity, cloud computing, AI-powered tools, gaming, and hardware devices.

Microsoft.com serves as the central hub for Microsoft's diverse product portfolio, from enterprise productivity solutions like Microsoft 365 and Teams to consumer devices like Surface and Xbox, all increasingly integrated with AI capabilities through Copilot. The site functions as both a product showcase and sales platform, offering information, support, and direct purchasing options across all major product categories.

## Key Topics

- Copilot AI
- Microsoft 365
- Windows 11
- Surface Devices
- Copilot+ PC
- Xbox Game Pass
- Microsoft Teams
- Cloud Computing
- AI Features
- Surface Pro
- Surface Laptop
- Xbox Consoles
- Microsoft Store
- Mixed Reality
- Subscription Services

## Core Products & Services

- [Microsoft Homepage](https://www.microsoft.com): Microsoft homepage showcasing AI, cloud, productivity, gaming products and services
- [Microsoft 365 for Individuals](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365): Microsoft 365 subscription product page with pricing plans and AI features
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Microsoft Teams collaboration and communication product overview page
- [Windows 11 Operating System](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows 11 operating system product page with AI and Copilot features
- [Microsoft Edge Browser](https://www.microsoft.com/edge): Microsoft Edge AI browser product overview with Copilot features

## Surface & Computing Devices

- [Microsoft Surface Devices](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/surface): Surface devices product line including laptops, tablets and Copilot+ PCs
- [Buy Laptops & PCs](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/pc): Microsoft Store PC and laptop shopping with Surface devices and Copilot+ PCs
- [PC & Computer Accessories](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/accessories): Microsoft Store PC accessories including Surface keyboards and Xbox peripherals

## Gaming & Entertainment

- [Xbox Consoles & Games](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/xbox): Xbox gaming consoles and Game Pass subscriptions in Microsoft Store
- [Xbox Game Pass Ultimate](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/xbox-game-pass-ultimate/cfq7ttc0khs0): Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription purchase page with game catalog
- [Xbox Game Pass Essential](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/xbox-live-gold/cfq7ttc0k5dj): Xbox Game Pass Essential subscription purchase page with console games

## Microsoft Store & Shopping

- [Microsoft Store - Deals & Sales](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/sale): Microsoft Store sales and deals on Surface, laptops, Xbox and software
- [Microsoft Store for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/business): Microsoft Store for Business with small business solutions and enterprise hardware

## Emerging Technologies

- [VR Headsets & Mixed Reality](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/b/virtualreality): Microsoft Store VR headsets including HoloLens 2 and mixed reality devices

## Support & Resources

- [Microsoft Support Hub](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft Support hub with how-to articles, videos and training resources

## Optional

- [Microsoft Movies & TV App](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/movies-and-tv): Microsoft Movies & TV app support page with FAQ and playback information
